about: Batch 04, slice A, chunk A47: hidden-veg kid dinners, leftover-roast makeovers, BBQ and grill nights, under-30-minute and freezer-to-table dinners.

recipes.title: Hidden-Veg Beef and Carrot Pasta Sauce with Spirals
recipes.summary: A smooth tomato beef sauce with carrot, zucchini and capsicum blended in, loved by fussy eaters.
steps: Brown the mince in the oil for 6 minutes until no pink remains, then add the onion, carrot, zucchini, capsicum and garlic and cook for 8 minutes until very soft.
Add the tomatoes and oregano and simmer for 15 minutes until thick, then blend with a stick blender until smooth.
Boil the fusilli for 10 minutes until al dente, drain and toss with the sauce.
notes: Food safety: mince must reach 75°C right through with no pink; refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and eat within 2 days.
Contains gluten.

recipes.title: Hidden-Veg Chicken Nuggets with Sweet Potato Wedges
recipes.summary: Baked nuggets with grated cauliflower and zucchini mixed in, served with sweet potato wedges.
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan). Squeeze the zucchini dry and mix with the chicken, cauliflower, first breadcrumbs, egg, garlic powder and salt.
Shape into 20 nuggets, roll in the second breadcrumbs and bake on a tray with half the oil for 20 minutes, turning once, until golden and 75°C inside.
Toss the wedges with the remaining oil and roast alongside for 30 minutes until crisp.
notes: Food safety: chicken nuggets must reach 75°C right through with no pink; wash hands after handling raw chicken and egg, and eat leftovers within 2 days.
Contains egg and gluten.

recipes.title: Hidden-Veg Mac and Cheese with Pumpkin
recipes.summary: Creamy macaroni cheese where pumpkin puree makes the sauce golden, sweet and extra nutritious.
steps: Boil the pumpkin in the milk for 12 minutes until soft, then blend until smooth.
Boil the macaroni for 8 minutes until tender, adding the peas for the last 2 minutes, then drain.
Heat the pumpkin sauce with the mustard, garlic powder and salt, stir in the cheese until melted, then fold through the pasta.
notes: Contains gluten and milk. Refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and eat within 3 days.

recipes.title: Hidden-Veg Meatballs in Tomato Sauce
recipes.summary: Soft beef meatballs hiding grated carrot and zucchini, simmered in mild tomato sauce.
steps: Squeeze the zucchini dry and mix with the mince, carrot, breadcrumbs, egg, oregano and salt and roll into 20 meatballs.
Brown in the oil for 5 minutes, add the tomatoes and garlic and simmer for 15 minutes until the meatballs reach 75°C and the sauce is thick.
Boil the spaghetti for 10 minutes until al dente and serve with the meatballs.
notes: Food safety: beef mince meatballs must reach 75°C right through with no pink; refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and eat within 2 days.
Contains egg and gluten.

recipes.title: Hidden-Veg Fish Fingers with Broccoli Mash
recipes.summary: Crumbed fish fingers with a green-tinged potato and broccoli mash kids happily eat.

items: 500g white fish fillet, cut into fingers

steps: Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan). Coat the fish in flour, egg then breadcrumbs, place on an oiled tray and bake for 15 minutes until golden and the fish flakes.
Boil the potato for 12 minutes, add the broccoli for 5 minutes more until both are very soft, then drain.
Mash with the butter, milk and salt until smooth and green-flecked and serve with the fish fingers.
notes: Food safety: fish should be opaque and flake easily, reaching 63°C; refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and eat within 1 day.
Contains fish, egg, gluten and milk.

recipes.title: Hidden-Veg Cheesy Chicken Quesadillas
recipes.summary: Crisp tortillas filled with melty cheese, shredded chicken and finely grated carrot and spinach.
steps: Cook the chicken in the oil for 6 minutes until cooked to 75°C, then add the carrot, spinach, cumin and salt for 2 minutes until wilted.
Fill half of each tortilla with the chicken mix and cheese, fold over and press.
Cook in a dry pan for 2 minutes a side until crisp and the cheese has melted. Slice into wedges.
notes: Food safety: chicken must reach 75°C with no pink; refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and eat within 2 days.
Contains gluten and milk.

recipes.title: Roast Chicken Leftover Fried Rice with Peas
recipes.summary: Use up cold roast chicken in a quick egg fried rice with peas, spring onion and soy sauce.
steps: Heat half the oil in a wok, scramble the eggs for 1 minute until set and tip out.
Stir-fry the garlic, chicken and peas in the remaining oil for 2 minutes, add the cold rice and fry for 4 minutes until hot and lightly crisp.
Return the egg with the soy sauce, sesame oil and spring onion and toss until steaming hot.
notes: Food safety: use roast chicken within 2 days of cooking, keep cooked rice chilled and refrigerate it within 1 hour, and reheat everything until steaming hot (75°C).
Contains egg, soy, gluten and sesame.

recipes.title: Roast Beef Leftover Hash with Fried Egg
recipes.summary: Crisp potato and onion hash with chopped cold roast beef, topped with a runny fried egg.
steps: Boil the potato for 6 minutes until just tender and drain well.
Fry the potato and onion in the oil for 10 minutes until crisp and golden, then add the beef, paprika, Worcestershire sauce and salt for 3 minutes until hot.
Fry the eggs in a little oil for 3 minutes until the whites are set and serve on the hash with parsley.
notes: Food safety: use roast beef within 2 days of cooking and reheat to 75°C; eggs should be cooked until the whites are set. Not for pregnant women or the elderly if the yolk is runny.
Contains egg. Worcestershire sauce contains fish and gluten.

recipes.title: Roast Lamb Leftover Pita Pockets with Tzatziki
recipes.summary: Shredded cold roast lamb warmed with cumin and stuffed into pita with crisp salad and tzatziki.
steps: Warm the lamb in the oil with the cumin and oregano for 5 minutes until steaming hot and edges crisp.
Squeeze the cucumber dry and stir into the yoghurt with the garlic.
Warm the pita, fill with the lamb, tomato and onion and spoon over the tzatziki.
notes: Food safety: use roast lamb within 2 days of cooking and reheat until steaming hot (75°C).
Contains gluten and milk.

recipes.title: Roast Pork Leftover Noodle Soup
recipes.summary: Slices of cold roast pork warmed in a ginger-soy broth with noodles, greens and a boiled egg.
steps: Boil the eggs for 7 minutes, cool in cold water, peel and halve.
Simmer the stock, soy sauce, ginger and garlic for 8 minutes until fragrant, add the noodles for 4 minutes until tender and the bok choy for the last 2 minutes.
Add the pork for 1 minute until steaming hot and serve topped with the eggs and spring onion.
notes: Food safety: use roast pork within 2 days of cooking and reheat until steaming hot (75°C); boil eggs until the whites are firm.
Contains egg, soy and gluten.

recipes.title: BBQ Lemon Herb Chicken Skewers with Greek Salad
recipes.summary: Juicy chicken skewers marinated in lemon and oregano, grilled and served with a crisp Greek salad.
steps: Marinate the chicken in half the oil, half the lemon juice, the garlic, oregano and salt for at least 30 minutes, then thread onto skewers.
Grill over medium-high heat for 10 minutes, turning, until charred and the chicken reaches 75°C.
Toss the tomato, cucumber, onion and olives with the remaining oil and lemon juice, crumble over the feta and serve with the skewers.
notes: Food safety: chicken must reach 75°C with no pink; keep marinade away from cooked food, wash hands and boards, and eat leftovers within 2 days.
Contains milk.

recipes.title: BBQ Honey Mustard Pork Chops with Corn on the Cob
recipes.summary: Sticky honey mustard pork chops grilled alongside buttery sweet corn.
steps: Mix the honey, mustard, oil, garlic and salt and brush over the chops.
Grill the corn over medium heat for 12 minutes, turning, and the chops for 5 minutes a side, basting until the pork reaches 70°C and is glazed.
Steam the beans for 5 minutes until tender, brush the corn with the butter and serve.
notes: Food safety: pork chops must reach 70°C, then rest 3 minutes; wash hands after handling raw pork and eat leftovers within 2 days.
Contains milk.

recipes.title: BBQ Smoky Prawn Skewers with Mango Salsa
recipes.summary: Paprika prawns flash-grilled and served with a fresh mango, lime and coriander salsa.
steps: Toss the prawns with the oil, paprika and garlic and thread onto skewers.
Mix the mango, onion, capsicum, lime juice and coriander for the salsa. Cook the rice for 12 minutes until tender.
Grill the skewers over high heat for 2 minutes a side until pink and opaque and serve with the salsa and rice.
notes: Food safety: cook prawns until pink and opaque; refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and eat within 1 day, and refrigerate rice within 1 hour.
Contains crustacean shellfish.

recipes.title: BBQ Beef Burgers with Grilled Pineapple and Slaw
recipes.summary: Thick beef burgers topped with charred pineapple and a creamy cabbage slaw.
steps: Mix the mince with the paprika and salt and shape into 4 patties.
Grill the patties over medium-high heat for 6 minutes a side until 75°C inside and the pineapple for 2 minutes a side until charred.
Toss the cabbage, carrot, yoghurt and lemon juice into a slaw and build the burgers in toasted buns.
notes: Food safety: burger patties must reach 75°C right through with no pink; refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and eat within 2 days.
Contains gluten and milk.

recipes.title: BBQ Lamb Cutlets with Minted Yoghurt and Zucchini
recipes.summary: Quick-grilled lamb cutlets with charred zucchini ribbons and a cooling mint yoghurt.
steps: Rub the cutlets with half the oil, garlic, cumin and salt. Toss the zucchini with the remaining oil.
Grill the cutlets for 3 minutes a side until browned, rest 3 minutes, and grill the zucchini for 3 minutes a side until charred.
Stir the mint and lemon juice into the yoghurt and serve with the lamb, zucchini and warmed flatbread.
notes: Food safety: lamb cutlets are whole cuts: sear all sides and rest, aiming for 63°C for medium or 71°C for well done; eat leftovers within 2 days.
Contains gluten and milk.

recipes.title: Quick Lemon Garlic Prawn and Zucchini Pasta in 20 Minutes
recipes.summary: Spaghetti with garlicky prawns and zucchini ribbons, on the table in 20 minutes.
steps: Boil the spaghetti for 10 minutes until al dente and keep half a cup of the water.
Sear the prawns in the oil for 2 minutes until pink, add the garlic, zucchini and chilli for 3 minutes until just tender.
Toss with the pasta, lemon zest and juice, parsley, salt and a splash of water until glossy.
notes: Food safety: cook prawns until pink and opaque; refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and eat within 1 day.
Contains gluten and crustacean shellfish.

recipes.title: Quick Chicken and Vegetable Teriyaki Noodles in 25 Minutes
recipes.summary: A fast stir-fry of chicken, carrot and cabbage in a sticky homemade teriyaki sauce.
steps: Boil the noodles for 4 minutes until tender and drain. Whisk the soy sauce, honey, vinegar, garlic and ginger together.
Stir-fry the chicken in the oil for 6 minutes until golden and cooked to 75°C, add the carrot and cabbage for 3 minutes.
Pour in the sauce and noodles and toss for 2 minutes until glossy and hot.
notes: Food safety: chicken must reach 75°C with no pink; refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and eat within 2 days.
Contains soy, gluten and egg.

recipes.title: Quick Black Bean and Corn Tostadas in 20 Minutes
recipes.summary: Crisp tortillas piled with spiced black beans, corn, avocado and lime, with no long cooking.
steps: Brush the tortillas with half the oil and bake at 200°C (180°C fan) for 6 minutes until crisp.
Warm the beans with the cumin, garlic and remaining oil for 5 minutes, mashing about half roughly.
Spread the beans over the tostadas and top with corn, avocado, tomato, lime juice, coriander and a spoonful of yoghurt.
notes: Contains milk. Refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours.

recipes.title: Quick Crisp Fish with Garlic Parsley Butter and Greens
recipes.summary: Crisp-skinned fish fillets in a bright caper butter with garlicky green beans and broccolini.
steps: Pat the fish dry, season with the salt and pan-fry in the oil for 4 minutes a side until golden and it flakes easily.
Steam the beans and broccolini for 5 minutes until tender-crisp.
Melt the butter with the parsley, lemon juice and garlic for 1 minute until foaming and spoon over the fish and greens.
notes: Food safety: fish should be opaque and flake easily, reaching 63°C; refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and eat within 1 day.
Contains fish and milk.

recipes.title: Quick Egg and Vegetable Shakshuka for the Family
recipes.summary: Eggs baked in spiced tomato and capsicum sauce, ready in 25 minutes with flatbread.
steps: Soften the onion and capsicum in the oil for 5 minutes, add the garlic and spices for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the tomatoes and salt and simmer for 8 minutes until thick. Make 6 wells and crack in the eggs.
Cover and cook for 5 minutes until the whites are set, scatter with parsley and serve with warm flatbread.
notes: Food safety: cook eggs until the whites are set and yolks thickened; keep out of reach if serving to pregnant women, infants or the elderly with runny yolks; eat leftovers within 2 days.
Contains egg and gluten.

recipes.title: Freezer-to-Table Chicken and Vegetable Curry
recipes.summary: Make a big batch, freeze in portions, and reheat from frozen for an easy weeknight curry.
steps: Brown the chicken in the oil for 6 minutes, add the onion, garlic and ginger for 5 minutes, then stir in the curry powder for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes, coconut milk, carrot and salt and simmer for 25 minutes until thick and the chicken reaches 75°C. Stir in the peas.
Cool within 1 hour, portion into containers and freeze for up to 3 months. Reheat from frozen in a covered pan over low heat for 20 minutes, stirring, until steaming hot.
notes: Food safety: chicken must reach 75°C with no pink; cool and freeze within 2 hours, thaw in the fridge if you prefer, reheat only once until steaming hot (75°C) and serve with freshly cooked rice.

recipes.title: Freezer-to-Table Beef and Bean Burritos
recipes.summary: Wrap, freeze and bake straight from frozen for a hot burrito dinner with no thawing.
steps: Brown the mince in the oil for 6 minutes until no pink remains, add the onion, garlic and spices for 4 minutes, then the beans, passata and salt and simmer for 8 minutes until thick. Cool.
Spoon onto the tortillas with the cheese, fold in the sides and roll tightly. Wrap individually and freeze.
Bake from frozen at 200°C (180°C fan) for 35 minutes, turning once, until golden and hot in the centre.
notes: Food safety: mince must reach 75°C with no pink, and the burritos 75°C in the centre after reheating; cool within 1 hour, freeze for up to 3 months and do not refreeze once baked.
Contains gluten and milk.

recipes.title: Freezer-to-Table Spinach and Ricotta Cannelloni
recipes.summary: Rolled pasta sheets filled with spinach and ricotta under tomato sauce, assembled and frozen ready to bake.
steps: Wilt the spinach in a pan for 2 minutes until soft, squeeze dry and mix with the ricotta, egg, nutmeg and salt. Simmer the tomatoes, garlic and oregano for 10 minutes until thick.
Spread the ricotta mix over the lasagne sheets, roll them up, lay seam-down in a dish, cover with sauce and mozzarella and wrap well. Freeze for up to 3 months.
Bake from frozen, covered, at 190°C (170°C fan) for 50 minutes, then uncovered for 10 minutes until golden and bubbling hot in the centre.
notes: Food safety: bake until hot through to 75°C in the centre; cool before freezing, do not refreeze after baking and eat leftovers within 2 days.
Contains gluten, egg and milk.

recipes.title: Freezer-to-Table Lentil and Vegetable Soup
recipes.summary: A thick, hearty vegan lentil soup that freezes brilliantly and reheats in minutes.
steps: Soften the onion, carrot, celery and garlic in the oil for 8 minutes until tender, then stir in the cumin and turmeric for 1 minute.
Add the lentils, tomatoes, stock and salt and simmer for 25 minutes until the lentils are soft. Blend half for a thicker texture and stir in the lemon juice.
Cool within 1 hour, freeze in portions for up to 3 months and reheat from frozen over low heat for 15 minutes, stirring, until steaming hot.
notes: Cool and freeze within 2 hours; reheat only once until steaming hot and eat within 2 days of thawing.
